text.KredimGeldi, bankaların kredi teklifleri: KredimGeldi is a fintech startup that brings banks' loan offers together on a single platform so you can meet your borrowing needs in the fastest and most transparent way.

text.Kredi almak isteyen biri için en zor kıs: For anyone looking to borrow, the hardest part is often finding the right offer. Every bank has different interest rates, fees and term options; researching them one by one takes time and makes comparison difficult.
text.KredimGeldi'yi bu yüzden kurduk. Bankala: That's why we founded KredimGeldi. We bring banks' offers together in one place and show the monthly installment, total repayment and cost including taxes side by side. That way, you see the full picture before deciding and can make an informed choice of the loan that best fits your budget.
text.Teklifleri karşılaştırmak için başvuru y: You don't need to apply to compare offers. Calculate first, then apply for the one that suits you.
text.Herkesin kredi tekliflerine kolayca ulaş: To deliver an experience where everyone can easily access loan offers, see costs clearly and complete their application in a single step.
text.Kredi, kredi kartı, mevduat ve sigorta g: To be the first digital comparison and application platform that comes to mind in Türkiye for every financial need, including loans, credit cards, deposits and insurance.
text.Her adımda bize yön veren ilkeler: The principles that guide us at every step
text.Faiz oranının yanında KKDF, BSMV ve topl: Alongside the interest rate, we also show KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund), BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax) and the total repayment, so there are no surprise costs.
text.Karmaşık süreçlerle uğraşmadan, dakikala: Skip the complicated processes: see offers and complete your application within minutes.
text.Kişisel verilerin KVKK kapsamında korunu: Your personal data is protected under KVKK and used only for your application.
text.Sade ve anlaşılır bir arayüzle kredi baş: With a simple, easy-to-understand interface, we make applying for a loan easy for everyone.
text.Finansal kararlarını bilgiyle vermen içi: We're here to help you make informed financial decisions
text.Doğru krediyi seçmek, yalnızca en düşük: Choosing the right loan isn't just about finding the lowest interest rate. The term, fees and your monthly budget all need to be considered together. KredimGeldi simplifies this decision for you.
text.Teklifler en düşük maliyetten başlayarak: Offers are ranked starting from the lowest cost.
text.Sonraki başvurularında aynı bilgileri ye: You won't need to retype the same details in your future applications.
